create_model_VGGplus: create a 2D SparseConvNet VGGplus model with sparse vgg blocks and linear classifier for 183 classes
build_sparsevggnet: build a 2D SparseVggNet with convolution, max-pooling layers and specified filter sizes
run_classification_train: run sparseconvnet classification training with model, dataset, and training hyperparameters
create_input_layer: create a 2D InputLayer for sparse convolutional network with spatial size and coordinate dimension
get_iterators_dataset: get data iterators for sparseconvnet training with specified spatial size and data scale
